datasets.name: Visual Anomaly (VisA)
datasets.domain_fit: Good for capsule-like multi-instance anomaly detection and pixel-level masks.
datasets.notes: Best first large dataset because it has normal/anomaly images and pixel masks.

datasets.name: MVTec AD
datasets.domain_fit: Strong industrial anomaly benchmark. Use capsule, pill, and bottle categories for pharma-inspired baselines.
datasets.notes: Non-commercial license. Download from MVTec after accepting terms, then pass the archive path to scripts/source_datasets.py.

datasets.name: Larger Blister Pack Defect
datasets.domain_fit: Most directly blister-pack-specific among open search results.
datasets.license: Check Roboflow project page/export terms before commercial use
datasets.notes: Use for YOLO-style supervised detection after setting ROBOFLOW_API_KEY.

datasets.name: Blister Strips' defect detection
datasets.domain_fit: Blister strip defect detector with more blister-specific samples.
datasets.license: Check Roboflow project page/export terms before commercial use
datasets.notes: Useful supervised dataset for visible blister/strip defects.

datasets.name: Blister Pack Defects
datasets.domain_fit: Small blister defect dataset for quick YOLO smoke tests.
datasets.notes: Small, but directly aligned with blister visual detection.
